assessments.reasoning: Shields's NYU SETL Project cover identifies the manual as version 30, dated July 24, 1984. Section 1.0 names the documented system as the NYU LITTLE implementation of SETL and identifies LITTLE as its implementation language.

challenge.method: Compared the title and version with the §1.0 scope notice and §§1.1–1.3 on implementation-specific features.
challenge.results: LITTLE is the implementation language named by Shields. The implementing system is the specific NYU SETL system described in v30. The manual distinguishes unimplemented, different and additional features.

limitations: The authority covers the NYU implementation documented by this manual, including the relevant LITTLE-visible interfaces and its scoped implementation limits.
